text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking through the central
plaza with Narita Brian...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: You saw that just now, didn't you?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Tch, this is the absolute worst...
